how_to_get_sections.title: Complete Special Challenge to Get Pizza
paragraphs: To get the Pizza item, you need to complete the special challenge Build Lots of Stuff! which you can get when you visit Palette Town .
For this challenge, you need to build 15 structure kits on Palette Town .
To get the Pizza, you need to have created atleast 15 Kits on Palette Island. The three Legendary Bird locations do count as three building kits, so you just need 12 to complete it.

how_to_use_sections.title: Power the Vending Machine
paragraphs: Place utility poles to create a line that connects from the vending machine to a power generator . These power sources include windmills , waterwheels , and furnaces .
You may find any of these power sources in the overworld. You may also purchase building kits for them in the PC Shop if you wish to place an additional one.
You may also temporarily power a vending machine with a Pokemon using the Generate Specialty.
The recipe for crafting utility poles is found on an island near the southwest corner of Bleak Beach . You can obtain it from a Pokeball near a furnace.

how_to_use_sections.title: Receive a Random Drink Once a Day
paragraphs: Once the vending machine is powered up, you may interact with it. Each vending machine will give you one random drink a day.

how_to_use_sections.title: Move or Pick Up the Vending Machine
paragraphs: You may want to move vending machines near generators in order to minimize the use of utility poles.

You may do this by picking them up with the Y button and placing them down again . Keep in mind that this will prevent you from receiving your daily drink if you have not used it yet . This will also remove the power from the vending machine if it was powered using Generate .
Alternatively, you may use Strength to push or pull them around.

how_to_get_sections.title: Befriend Scyther
paragraphs: Lumber is obtained by processing small logs with Scyther's (or any Pokemon with a Chop specialty) help.

With that said, the first step to getting lumber in the early game is befriending Scyther . They will appear on Tree-shaded tall grass , which is a habitat made by growing 4 tiles of tall grass next to a large tree.

how_to_get_sections.title: Gather Small Logs
paragraphs: Soon after befriending Scyther, they will ask for 2 sturdy sticks through a request that will unlock the Move Cut . This Move allows you to shred wooden objects, like trees and log piles, to obtain small logs . These small logs are the raw materials required to get lumber.
Aside from logs, trees can also drop seeds when you cut them down. Be sure to plant these seeds and tend to them so that you have a steady supply of logs and lumber.
Some Pokemon can also give you seeds as a gift after befriending them.

how_to_get_sections.title: Process Small Logs Into Lumber
paragraphs: Bring the small logs that you've collected to Scyther , and they will start processing them into lumber! The process takes some time, so you'll need to return later to collect the finished product.
Later on in the game, you can obtain lumber by giving small logs to any Pokemon with the Chop specialty .

paragraphs: Pokemetal may be obtained by processing a Pokemetal fragments into a smelting furnace with the help of a Pokemon with the Burn Specialty. It takes some time to process, so try to stock up and keep your Pokemon friends busy!
Pokemetal fragments are obtained by breaking Pokemetal Blocks using the enhanced Rock Smash .
The recipe for Smelting Furnace may be obtained by meeting Magmar during the Rocky Ridge main story .

You can find Pokemetal Blocks to get Pokemetal fragments from in the Withered Wasteland mine. The mine entrance is located north of the island , and it is blocked by a gate fence that can be removed using enhanced Cut .
To find the Pokemetal inside, proceed down the steps after entering, then immediately turn left at the fork and follow the railway track .

Pokemetal Blocks can also be found in Sparkling Skylands, on the floating island to the east . To reach the area, you'll need to learn how to transform into a Dragonite first by progressing through the main story.
If you are visiting the east island for the first time, you will encounter Gardevoir, who will direct you to the Pokemetal location.
You can also find Pokemetal Block to farm Pokemetal fragments by visiting Sky Dream Island. You can get there by giving Drifloon a Dragonite doll , which you may do once every day.

Trade Pokemon can also set up shop inside a rebuilt Pokemon Center .

how_to_get_sections.title: Look for Glowing Spots in the Ground
paragraphs: Breaking Glowing Spot are the only way you can obtain Mysterious Slates . If the Glowing Spot is in front of you, you must use Rock Smash in order to destroy and break the block open.
Ancient Artifacts such as Lost Relics, CDs, Fossils, and other rare Materials can also be acquired by breaking Glowing Spots, so be prepared for a lot of tradeable and giftable items.

how_to_get_sections.title: Dowsing Machine With a Search Pokemon
paragraphs: The Dowsing Machine is used to search for more Glowing Spots . In order to start searching, you must first have a Pokemon that has a Search Specialty to follow you.
We recommend the ones that can fly or float since the landlocked Pokemon can get stuck if you swim or fly around.

how_to_get_sections.title: Give Mosslax Bitter Food
paragraphs: Giving Mosslax Bitter food, like a Salad with a Leaf and Seaweed as Ingredients , will increase the odds of finding rare items ! Try to plan out your searches when feeling him to not waste time.

how_to_get_sections.title: Try Looking During Sundays
paragraphs: During Lucky Days, Glowing Spots are more frequent , giving you more rewards to reap from exploring during this time.

how_to_get_sections.title: Glowing Spots Are Refreshed Everyday
paragraphs: Glowing Spots will refresh everyday, so do make it your daily task to dig up as many per map. If you don't mind changing the date , you can increase your efficiency by continuously changing it to Sunday .

how_to_get_sections.title: Cannot be 3D Printed
paragraphs: Despite being able to take a photo of the blocks, you cannot 3D Print these blocks to cheat your way from looking for them.

how_to_get_sections.title: Mural Completion Will Not Stop Spawn
paragraphs: Even after completing the Mural, Mysterious Slates will still spawn in your world . You can sell these via Trades for easy barters!

how_to_use_sections.title: Attach Mysterious Slates to Unown Letters
paragraphs: You can attach Mysterious Slates that you find around the area to the Mysterious Mural. You will need to match them according to the corresponding Unown Alphabet found on the back of the slate.
Attaching all 27 Slates to the correct symbols will unlock the Pokemon, Mew, as a townsfolk.
The Mysterious Mural can be found northeast of the Pokemon Center in the Withered Wasteland . You will need to break the wall there to find the hidden area.
Afterwards, break the wall to the left where you see the chiseled blocks . This will uncover a set of stairs going down, which leads to the Mysterious Mural.

how_to_use_sections.title: No Other Purpose Except Decor
paragraphs: Other than the mural, the Mysterious Slates will do nothing than just be bag filler. You can put them on the ground and check behind to see what letters they correspond to though.

how_to_get_sections.title: Look for Glowing Spots in the Ground
paragraphs: Breaking Glowing Spot are the only way you can obtain Mysterious Slates . If the Glowing Spot is in front of you, you must use Rock Smash in order to destroy and break the block open.
Ancient Artifacts such as Lost Relics, CDs, Fossils, and other rare Materials can also be acquired by breaking Glowing Spots, so be prepared for a lot of tradeable and giftable items.

how_to_get_sections.title: Dowsing Machine With a Search Pokemon
paragraphs: The Dowsing Machine is used to search for more Glowing Spots . In order to start searching, you must first have a Pokemon that has a Search Specialty to follow you.
We recommend the ones that can fly or float since the landlocked Pokemon can get stuck if you swim or fly around.

how_to_get_sections.title: Give Mosslax Bitter Food
paragraphs: Giving Mosslax Bitter food, like a Salad with a Leaf and Seaweed as Ingredients , will increase the odds of finding rare items ! Try to plan out your searches when feeling him to not waste time.

how_to_get_sections.title: Try Looking During Sundays
paragraphs: During Lucky Days, Glowing Spots are more frequent , giving you more rewards to reap from exploring during this time.

how_to_get_sections.title: Glowing Spots Are Refreshed Everyday
paragraphs: Glowing Spots will refresh everyday, so do make it your daily task to dig up as many per map. If you don't mind changing the date , you can increase your efficiency by continuously changing it to Sunday .

how_to_get_sections.title: Cannot be 3D Printed
paragraphs: Despite being able to take a photo of the blocks, you cannot 3D Print these blocks to cheat your way from looking for them.

how_to_get_sections.title: Mural Completion Will Not Stop Spawn
paragraphs: Even after completing the Mural, Mysterious Slates will still spawn in your world . You can sell these via Trades for easy barters!

how_to_use_sections.title: Attach Mysterious Slates to Unown Letters
paragraphs: You can attach Mysterious Slates that you find around the area to the Mysterious Mural. You will need to match them according to the corresponding Unown Alphabet found on the back of the slate.
Attaching all 27 Slates to the correct symbols will unlock the Pokemon, Mew, as a townsfolk.
The Mysterious Mural can be found northeast of the Pokemon Center in the Withered Wasteland . You will need to break the wall there to find the hidden area.
Afterwards, break the wall to the left where you see the chiseled blocks . This will uncover a set of stairs going down, which leads to the Mysterious Mural.

how_to_use_sections.title: No Other Purpose Except Decor
paragraphs: Other than the mural, the Mysterious Slates will do nothing than just be bag filler. You can put them on the ground and check behind to see what letters they correspond to though.
Either stuff them in a Storage Box until they're completed, or you can come back to the Mural everytime you pick one up and slot them in there one-by-one .
